name: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
credit: Portrait of Kobayashi Issa, Edo period · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons). Epigrams and English versions: Basil Hall Chamberlain, 'Bashō and the Japanese Poetical Epigram', Transactions of the Asiatic Society of Japan, vol. 30 (Yokohama, 1902), as read from the Internet Archive scans of that volume.
bio: 小林一茶 (Kobayashi Issa, 1763–1828) was born in Kashiwabara in Shinano Province (now Nagano Prefecture), lost his mother as a small child, and left home for Edo as a youth to study haikai. He spent years travelling and living in poverty before returning to his native village, where he wrote the diary and verse collections for which he is best known. He is remembered as one of the great masters of the hokku, or haiku, after Bashō and Buson, for his colloquial diction and his tenderness towards small creatures.

These are the four epigrams that Basil Hall Chamberlain attributes to Issa in his 1902 essay on Bashō and the Japanese poetical epigram, each given as he prints it in romanised Japanese and then in his English version, with his commentary left out. The text was corrected line by line against page images of two scans of the Transactions.

poems.title: Ware to kite
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Ware to kite
Asobe ya oya no
Nai suzume

poems.title: You little sparrows left without
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
You little sparrows left without
A mother, come and play with me.

poems.title: Nan no sono
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Nan no sono
Hyaku-man-goku mo
Sasa no tsuyu

poems.title: What then? what are his million bales?
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
What then? what are his million bales?
Mere dewdrops on the bamboo grass.

poems.title: Yase-kawazu
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Yase-kawazu
Makeru-na Issa
Kore ni ari

poems.title: Emaciated frog! be not
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Emaciated frog! be not
Worsted in fight:—Issa is here.

poems.title: Yare! naku-na
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Yare! naku-na
Sore hodo buji de
Kaeru kari

poems.title: Hallo! you shouldn't cry, you storks
poems.author: Kobayashi Issa 小林一茶
poems.text:
Hallo! you shouldn't cry, you storks,
Returning home so safe and sound!
